notes.title: GunBlocks Update - Drone Race
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39359669/a326b0a7fa1a1fef242a995f19217db0f88eadcd.png[/img]

Dear fellows!

After a period of silence we can proudly present you the first major content update for the GunBlocks Prologue! In this side quest you challenge the drones in a wild race without any rules. You might need practice to master all three difficulties, but don't give up!

You can access the drone race on the first island once the main quest is finished. As this is still a beta version, we're (again) very grateful for any feedback. Use the in-game reporting tool or our Discord server.
Go go go!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kBzWUNg.gif[/img]

Also our newsletter is online, [url=https://www.gunblocks.com/]subscribe [/url]today and stay updated for ever :D

Enjoy the race and let me know how fun it was!
- Steve

notes.title: Prologue out Now!
notes.content:
Happy new year to everyone!

GunBlocks has its own little release today as the prologue got its own Steam page! That means it will be permanently available to play, it has achievements and you can review it.

So it would be really nice to take a look and write down your thoughts in a review. Thanks!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1492720

The release for chapter 1 will be late spring or early summer hopefully.

Have a good one!
 - Steve
